en.title: Weird story: It’s impossible to become addicted while working!

My feeling at the time was that it could bring people an experience of "relieving stress through simple actions and finding flow" and "it is super difficult to get started, but the more you play, the easier it becomes"; more than 3,000 books can make people feel happy from the bottom of their hearts, from chaos to order. However, from another perspective, the "replayability" of this game is actually not high. At least it is difficult for me to muster the courage to open it a second time, and I don't even want to play similar games - precisely because I know how tiring the process is, I don't want to repeat the work. When you enter "Librarian", you will see a scene like this. I am already feeling tired before I start working. But recently I found that many people still like it.

items.title: YouTubeの有料動画広告がマルウェア配布に悪用されていた事例をセキュリティ企業が報告

en.title: Security company reports case where paid video ads on YouTube were being misused to distribute malware
en.summary: Security company SafeDep reported that a paid video ad was being distributed on YouTube that advertised ``You can use the stock charting service TradingView for free for one year,'' and users who clicked on the ad were being directed to a fake app containing malware. Although the newly infected terminal that SafeDep analyzed was a Mac, attacks that distribute Windows malware from malicious advertisements disguised as TradingView have also been confirmed for some time. read more...

items.title: ネットユーザーは人気のネコ動画に映る「ネコが嫌がっているサイン」にほとんど気付いていない
items.summary: SNSやショート動画サイトを見ていると、かなりの頻度で「かわいいネコの動画」が流れてきます。ネコ動画は多くのユーザーから人気を集めていますが、中には動画中でネコが嫌がっていたり苦痛を感じていたりするものもあります。そんな動画に映るネコの苦痛などの反応に、ネットユーザーはほとんど気が付いていないとの研究結果が報告されました。続きを読む...

zh.title: 互联网用户几乎没有注意到流行猫视频中的“猫不喜欢的迹象”
zh.summary: 当我浏览SNS和短视频网站时，我经常会看到“可爱的猫咪视频”。猫咪视频越来越受到许多用户的欢迎，但有些视频显示了猫的仇恨或痛苦。研究表明，网民在此类视频中几乎不会注意到猫的反应，例如疼痛。阅读更多...
